command_applicability.command_recommendation: Create the exact source job with explicit approved M.2 `filename`, invoke verified fio and add full structured output/monitoring while retaining libaio/direct1/read/512b/iodepth1/numjobs1/ramp10/runtime43200/time_based settings unless a reviewed duration variant is authorized.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a serial-locked M.2 read job while tracking PCIe link and thermal throttling continuously, then compare complete QD1 latency/throughput evidence to an M.2-specific matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds M.2 namespace/link/power/cooling identity, read-safety proof, structured evidence, thermal validity and thresholds.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: M.2 devices can thermally throttle well before host instability; a numerically low result may reflect cooling/ASPM/link width rather than media capability.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Performance row10 Wistron-Performance Storage-00013-V004: approve exact non-production M.2 model/serial/namespace/path, PCIe root-port generation/width, filesystem/raw/cache/read-ahead/power state and ownership; fio version/package/hash and `rw=read`/`overwrite=1` safety; retain43200s or approve a separately identified duration variant; provide M.2 read512B/QD1/numjobs1 thresholds/tolerances/repetitions and composite/controller thermal, SMART/media/AER abort limits.

review_improvement: Makes M.2 link and thermal behavior part of result validity while preserving the exact long-duration QD1 read coverage and preventing unsafe target or shortened-output substitution.
independent_technical_reasoning: At QD1/512B, latency dominates and PCIe generation/width may not be the sole bottleneck, yet link downgrades and power states still change results. Over12 hours an M.2 device can enter thermal throttling, so average BW without a temperature/time trace can misclassify cooling as storage performance. Serial/namespace identity prevents path renumbering errors. The full fio record must prove actual runtime and tail latency, and any shortened run is a distinct variant rather than equivalent evidence.
